(async () => { const G = window.G, Z = G.X.ZUHAUSE, h = Z.home; if (G.player.car) G.toggleCar(); G.player.wanted = 0; if (G.STORY && G.STORY.busy) G.STORY.stop(); G.player.pos.set(h.ex, G.TH(h.ex, h.ez), h.ez); if (G.player.mesh) G.player.mesh.position.copy(G.player.pos); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500)); const t = (G.X.fHooks || []).map(f => f()).find(r => r && /Nach Hause/.test(r.label)); if (t) t.act(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); return JSON.stringify({ tuer: t ? t.label : null, drin: G.INTERIORS.inside ? G.INTERIORS.inside.label : null }); })()

(async () => { const G = window.G, Z = G.X.ZUHAUSE; const ok = Z.menu('schrank'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); const b = document.querySelector('#zuhausemenu button[data-o=lauf]'); if (b) b.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); return JSON.stringify({ ok, knopf: !!b, look: Z.look(), gespeichert: localStorage.getItem('notgta.outfit'), offen: document.getElementById('zuhausemenu').style.display }); })()

(async () => { const G = window.G, Z = G.X.ZUHAUSE; window.__h0 = G.world.hour; G.player.wanted = 2; const r = await Z.sleep(1); G.player.wanted = 0; return JSON.stringify({ r, h: G.world.hour }); })()

(async () => { const G = window.G, Z = G.X.ZUHAUSE; window.__t0 = Date.now(); window.__h0 = G.world.hour; G.player.hp = 40; const ok = Z.menu('bett'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); const b = document.querySelector('#zuhausemenu button[data-h="3"]'); if (b) b.click(); return JSON.stringify({ ok, knopf: !!b, h0: window.__h0 }); })()
expect: (() => { const G = window.G, d = (G.world.hour - window.__h0 + 24) % 24, s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('notgta.save') || 'null'); return d > 2.9 && d < 3.5 && !!s && s.when >= window.__t0 && Math.abs(s.hour - G.world.hour) < 0.5 && Math.abs(s.pos[0]) < 50000 && G.player.hp >= 99; })()

js: (async () => { const G = window.G, Z = G.X.ZUHAUSE, h = Z.home; G.INTERIORS.leave(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500)); return JSON.stringify({ drin: !!G.INTERIORS.inside, d: Math.hypot(G.player.pos.x - h.ex, G.player.pos.z - h.ez) }); })()

(async () => { const G = window.G, Z = G.X.ZUHAUSE; G.player.pos.set(-60, G.TH(-60, 300), 300); const g = Z.guide(true); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); const an = Z.guiding; Z.guide(false); Z.outfit('alltag'); return JSON.stringify({ g, an, aus: !Z.guiding, outfit: localStorage.getItem('notgta.outfit') }); })()
